# Jewel Stone

> NYC Diamond District jeweler, family jewelry knowledge since 1980. Creates natural, PIECUT, and lab-grown diamond jewelry, plus fully custom bespoke pieces, in-house at 62 W 47th St, Suite 505, New York, NY 10036. By appointment.

Jewel Stone sells engagement rings, wedding bands, earrings, pendants, bracelets, necklaces, and loose GIA/IGI-certified diamonds (natural, lab-grown, and proprietary PIECUT-cut stones), and designs one-of-a-kind custom jewelry from an initial sketch through in-house fabrication. All shipping is insured and complimentary. Returns accepted within 14 days.

## Key pages

- [Collections](https://thejewelstone.com/collections): engagement rings, wedding bands, earrings, pendants, bracelets, necklaces
- [Diamonds](https://thejewelstone.com/diamonds): loose certified natural, lab-grown, and PIECUT diamonds, filterable by cut/carat/clarity/color
- [Custom Design](https://thejewelstone.com/custom): bespoke jewelry made to order, sketch to finished piece
- [About](https://thejewelstone.com/about): history since 1980, founder background
- [Showroom](https://thejewelstone.com/showroom): by-appointment visit information
- [Contact](https://thejewelstone.com/contact): appointment booking, inquiries
- [Education](https://thejewelstone.com/education): diamond buying guides, the 4Cs, certification explained
